text: category billing: Customer requests information on accepted payment methods and help with a declined payment.
Fetching policy on accepted payment methods and declined payments.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Accepted payment methods and how to resolve declined card payments at checkout (supported card brands, wallets, regional availability, retry steps)."}

passages.title: Payment questions and invoice requests
passages.text:
POL-BIL-01 v1.1: Payment questions and invoice requests
Conditions: Match payments.order_id to an owned order. Use amount_cents, status, method, and captured_at to explain charges. Checkout accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover credit or debit cards.
Rules: Explain a verified charge using its date, amount, and related order. Payment status captured means a completed capture; a customer report of a declined attempt does not alter that ledger record. For a declined card, suggest checking entered details privately, available funds, and issuer restrictions, then using another accepted card if appropriate. Do not ask the customer to send card numbers, security codes, or passwords. No invoice document, invoice link, or invoice-creation tool exists. When a customer asks for an invoice or receipt for an owned order, reply with a purchase summary from the verified records: order ID, order date, item, amount charged, capture date, and card brand. After the message receipt, the ticket can be resolved. For missing order details, ask the customer. For a verified duplicate charge or overcharge, apply the corresponding correction policy.
Exceptions: Call the reply a purchase summary; never claim an official invoice or PDF was generated or attached. Ticket-quoted invoice numbers are unverified. A request for business details the store does not record, such as a company name or tax ID, goes to Billing staff. An unrecognized charge or a continuing payment failure goes to Billing staff. Suspected fraud follows POL-FRD-01.

passages.title: Partial refunds and billing corrections
passages.text:
POL-RET-06 v1.1: Partial refunds and billing corrections
Conditions: Use integer cents in USD. Read orders.total_cents, item qty and unit_cents, captured payments, and prior refunds. Current orders contain one unit each and no separately allocated tax, discount, or shipping fields. Do not invent additional monetary components.
Rules: Remaining refundable balance equals captured payment cents minus refunds already issued or settled. Apply that limit across all requests for the order. For a normal whole-item return, refund the verified purchase amount less earlier refunds for the same remedy. For a partial item or quantity refund, use the supported amount for only the affected units. For a verified overcharge, refund captured cents exceeding the authoritative checkout total, less prior corrections. Do not refund the legitimate charge. Duplicate captures use POL-BIL-02. An order paid at 13,999 cents with 4,199 cents already refunded has at most 9,800 cents remaining. An approval for 13,999 cents cannot be resized or reused for 9,800 cents; staff must reconcile it and provide an exact new approval.
Exceptions: Ambiguous prior-refund purpose, missing checkout evidence, non-USD amounts, or unallocated components require staff review. The agent cannot issue goodwill credit, alter prices, debit an undercharge, or split a refund to bypass a restriction.

passages.title: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
passages.text:
POL-ORD-01 v1.1: Cancellation and payment reversal requests
Conditions: Read the latest owned order.status and shipment record. An order with status processing and no shipment record can be cancelled with cancel_order; no staff approval is needed. cancel_order checks ownership and status itself and refuses shipped orders. It cannot intercept a shipment.
Rules: For an owned unshipped order, call cancel_order with the order ID. After a successful receipt, tell the customer the order is cancelled and the payment is reversed to the original payment method, quoting the receipt ID. The ticket can then be resolved. For a shipped order, explain that the agent cannot stop the shipment and that a delivered eligible item may use the 30-day return process under POL-RET-01. Escalate the cancellation or interception request to Billing staff. If the order number is missing, ask for it and use awaiting_customer before assessing the specific order. General cancellation guidance does not require an order number. A guidance-only cancellation question can be resolved after a message receip…

result.response: Hi Aisha — We currently accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover cards for checkout. If your card was declined, please try the following steps: 1) Double-check the card details you entered at checkout (card number, expiration date, and billing address) without sharing full numbers. 2) Check with your bank to ensure there are sufficient funds and that there are no issuer restrictions or holds on the card. 3) If it still doesn’t work, try a different card from our accepted list. Please avoid sharing full card numbers or CVV in chat. If you can share the exact error message you saw (without revealing sensitive data), I can help interpret it and suggest next steps or escalate to Billing if needed.
